SELECT C.CPNY_NO, C.CPNY_ID, C.CPNY_LOCATION, C.CPNY_ADDR, C.CPNY_POSTALCODE, C.CPNY_INTRO, C.CPNY_HISTORY, C.CPNY_WEB_ADDR, C.CPNY_TEL_NO, C.CPNY_FAX_NO, C.ORDERNO, C.ACTIVITY, C.GGS_YN, TO_CHAR(C.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') CREATE_DATE, C.CREATED_BY, G.CONTENT CONTENT FROM HR_COMPANY C, SY_GLOBAL_NAME G WHERE C.CPNY_NO = G.NO(+) AND G.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND C.ACTIVITY = '1'
G.CONTENT LIKE '%' || #CONTENT:VARCHAR# || '%'
C.CPNY_NO = #NO:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(CPNY_NO)

SELECT C.CPNY_NO, C.CPNY_ID, C.CPNY_LOCATION, C.CPNY_ADDR, C.CPNY_POSTALCODE, C.CPNY_INTRO, C.CPNY_HISTORY, C.CPNY_WEB_ADDR, C.CPNY_TEL_NO, C.CPNY_FAX_NO, C.ORDERNO, TO_CHAR(C.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') CREATE_DATE, C.CREATED_BY, C.CPNY_ID CONTENT FROM HR_COMPANY C WHERE 1=1
C.ACTIVITY = #ACTIVITY:NUMERIC#

SELECT C.CPNY_NO, C.CPNY_ID, C.CPNY_LOCATION, C.CPNY_ADDR, C.CPNY_POSTALCODE, C.CPNY_INTRO, C.CPNY_HISTORY, C.CPNY_WEB_ADDR, C.CPNY_TEL_NO, C.CPNY_FAX_NO, C.ORDERNO, TO_CHAR(C.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') CREATE_DATE, C.CREATED_BY, C.CPNY_ID CONTENT FROM HR_COMPANY C WHERE C.ACTIVITY = 1

sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO HR_COMPANY( CPNY_NO, CPNY_ID, CPNY_LOCATION, CPNY_ADDR, CPNY_POSTALCODE, CPNY_INTRO, CPNY_HISTORY, CPNY_WEB_ADDR, CPNY_TEL_NO, CPNY_FAX_NO, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY , ACTIVITY, OPERATION_ID, GGS_YN ) VALUES( #NO:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_LOCATION#, #CPNY_ADDR#, #CPNY_POSTALCODE#, #CPNY_INTRO#, #CPNY_HISTORY#, #CPNY_WEB_ADDR#, #CPNY_TEL_NO#, #CPNY_FAX_NO#, SYSDATE, #CREATED_BY:VARCHAR#, #ACTIVITY:NUMERIC#, #OPERATION_ID#, #GGS_YN# )
sqlMap.update: UPDATE HR_COMPANY SET CPNY_ID=#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#, CPNY_LOCATION=#CPNY_LOCATION:VARCHAR#, CPNY_ADDR=#CPNY_ADDR:VARCHAR#, CPNY_INTRO=#CPNY_INTRO:VARCHAR#, CPNY_HISTORY=#CPNY_HISTORY:VARCHAR#, CPNY_WEB_ADDR=#CPNY_WEB_ADDR:VARCHAR#, CPNY_TEL_NO=#CPNY_TEL_NO:VARCHAR#, CPNY_FAX_NO=#CPNY_FAX_NO:VARCHAR#, UPDATE_DATE=SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY=#UPDATED_BY:VARCHAR#, ACTIVITY=#ACTIVITY#, OPERATION_ID=#OPERATION_ID#, GGS_YN=#GGS_YN# WHERE CPNY_NO = #CPNY_NO:VARCHAR#
sqlMap.select: SELECT T.OPERATION_NO, T.OPERATION_ID, n.content OPERATION_NAME, T.CURRENCY_NO, T.CURRENCY_ID, T.LANGUAGE, T.OPERATION_CODE_NO FROM HR_OPERATION T,SY_GLOBAL_NAME N WHERE T.ACTIVITY = 1 AND T.OPERATION_NO = N.NO(+) AND N.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage#
